name: Octopus ring: Thomas pulse, 100 ms + 20 ms per coil, counter-clockwise (Cook 1999)
origin: Persinger & Koren lab, Laurentian University (circumcerebral 'Octopus': Cook 1999, Richards 2002)
summary: Configuration 5 of the Persinger lab's ring battery: the Thomas pulse at 1-ms points stepped counter-clockwise round a ring of 8 coils, 100 ms on the first coil and 20 ms more on each next one (to 240 ms). The lab reported the longest 10-s estimates with it (12.2 s against 9.1 s for clockwise, 7 people each; Cook 1999) and 20 to 30% more theta power than with its five other configurations (8 people; Richards 2002).
notes: Cook 1999 Table 1 (p.2 [62]) and Richards 2002 Table 1 (p.4 [674]) give configuration 5 as frequency-modulated, 1-ms points, 1 ms between repeats, 100 ms on the first solenoid and +20. Both spell out 100, 120 ... 240 ms (Cook p.3 [63], with '340' misprinted for 240; Richards p.12 [682]). Each configuration ran 5 min, with the 10-s estimate at 2.5 min (Cook p.2-3 [62-63]). This program plays those values as published, for this one configuration alone: the 849-point Thomas table (US 6,234,953) at 1 ms per point, 1 ms between repeats (0.85 s per burst), one coil at a time, counter-clockwise from Fp1 (100 ms) to Fp2 (240 ms). The site names are this project's reading of a ring with a solenoid every 45 degrees. The right-side coils get the longer dwells (180 to 240 ms); persinger-octopus-plus20-cw is the mirror image. The full batteries are persinger-cook-1999-time-ccw and persinger-cook-1999-time-cw. Booth 2008 and the lab's later papers read + as shorter and describe this row as 100, 80, 60, 40, 20, 1, 1, 1 ms (Booth 2008 p.4 [429]); that version is not this program. The papers give 5 to 10 uT adjacent to the scalp (Cook p.2 [62]; Richards p.3 [673]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 5 uT the scalp gets about 120 uT, 12 to 24 times the papers' value; about 0.3 uT matches it. Cook had 7 people per direction and no sham group; Richards had 8 people and gives 'about 20%' more theta power than with the other five configurations, '20% to 30%' (p.12 [682]). Single lab, never independently replicated; time estimates are easily swayed by expectation. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for anyone with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated, eyes closed, in a quiet, dim room. For the original measures, estimate a 10-s interval 2.5 min in, with the field on, or record EEG during the session.
schedule: One 5-min session, the length of each configuration in Cook 1999; compare with the other direction on a separate day.
